title: Vaai Kozhuppu
desc: Bhaskar struggles to earn the admiration and approval of his rich father-in-law. To make matters worse, he is constantly belittled by the elder son-in-law of the family.
After witnessing a murder, James enlists Aishwarya to help uncover the conspiracies hidden within the community, leading to shocking revelations.

title: Vidhi
desc: When Radha falls in love with Raja, a rich lawyer's son, and ends up pregnant, Raja and his father refuse to acknowledge paternity. She decides to take the matter to court to seek justice.

title: Guna
desc: Guna imagines a fictitious character of a woman to be his future wife. One day, he sees a girl in a temple and assumes that she is his imaginary love and kidnaps her.

title: Petta
desc: In a bid to save his best friend's son Anwar, hostel warden Kaali goes against local goons. However, everything goes haywire when he is forced to face his past.

title: Bhavani IPS
desc: Bhavani, an honest police officer, is posted as an ACP in Tirunelveli, a land ruled by Sivalingam, a thug and aspiring politician. Her efforts to enforce law bring her in direct conflict with Siva.

title: Kaadhal Solla Vandhen
desc: Prabhu, a fresher in college, falls in love with Sandhya, his senior. However, this does not go well with her classmates, and they start to create problems for him.

title: Kangalal Kaidhu Sei
desc: Despite inheriting a huge fortune from his parents, Vaseegaran, a kleptomaniac, steals a diamond from a store and Vidhya, a salesgirl, is blamed. However, while clearing her name, he falls in love.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Ennamma Kannu
desc: Kaasi, a womaniser, tries to woo Gayatri, a young woman, but she thwarts his advances. However, when her fiancé deserts her on the day of her wedding, Kaasi offers her refuge.
